Chapter 196: Chapter 4: The Heiyu Family (Please Subscribe)

“Indeed.”

“With Mr. Lin’s talent and ability, Canglan Star was always too small.”

“Just a middle-grade life planet. My Xiangwen Group has a Sixth Rank Fallen Star Warrior in residence; that’s the stage truly suited for Mr. Lin Yuan.”

The blond middle-aged man, smiling, continued, “Moreover, Lord Xiangwen holds Mr. Lin in high regard and might even personally offer some guidance in the future…”

Lord Xiangwen…

Is the Sixth Rank Fallen Star Warrior behind the Xiangwen Group.

...

The guidance of a Sixth Rank Evolver is a great opportunity for most Evolvers.

Sixth Rank Evolvers possess the power of Fallen Stars,

From their high positions, with a mere few casual tips,

They could provoke sudden enlightenment in Fourth or Fifth Rank Evolvers.

The blond middle-aged man believed that Lin Yuan would find it hard to ignore this condition.

Lin Yuan indeed had great potential,

Having entered Fourth Rank before the age of a hundred, with a good chance to become a Fifth Rank Evolver in the future.

But that was about it.

Thinking of progressing further and breaking through to the Sixth Rank level still seemed a remote hope.

Therefore,

The guidance of a Sixth Rank Evolver was certainly not to be missed.

“Sorry, I’m not interested in joining other factions.” Lin Yuan shook his head and said.

What a joke? According to the blond middle-aged man, joining the Xiangwen Group would require signing numerous contracts.

It even required Lin Yuan to personally go to the headquarters of the Xiangwen Group for scrutiny.

And the conditions offered by the blond middle-aged man, while attractive to ordinary Fourth Rank Evolvers, what about to Lin Yuan?

Furthermore,

Lin Yuan’s true identity, the Peak Master of the Red Kun Lineage,

Was almost akin to the status of a prince in an empire, and not just any prince, but one with real power.

If he joined the Xiangwen Group, it would be akin to fighting in arena competitions for other star domains.

How absurd is that?

“Mr. Lin, won’t you reconsider?” the blond middle-aged man’s face slightly changed.

Although the Xiangwen Group was not in the Chikun Star Domain, it was still a major force with a Sixth Rank Fallen Star Warrior at its core.

Even if Lin Yuan had other options and wouldn’t join the Xiangwen Group, there was no need to outright say it.

Mincing his words a bit would help save some face for everyone.

“As I said, I’m not interested, and I won’t reconsider.”

Lin Yuan shook his head; his primary goal now was to step into Sixth Rank as quickly as possible.

All other matters unrelated to this breakthrough were just trivia.

“Okay.”

“Lord Xiangwen would probably be quite disappointed to learn of this.”

The blond middle-aged man, his face turning a bit ugly, stood up intending to take his leave.

“What’s the matter?”

“Is your Lord Xiangwen going to come over here and teach me a lesson?”

Lin Yuan spoke.

In the Cosmic Human Alliance, laws are robust, the more powerful the Evolver, the greater the restrictions they face.

Even those esteemed evolutionary scholars high above could not act wantonly, let alone a Sixth Rank.

If that Lord Xiangwen dared come to Canglan Star, revealing any intent to act against Lin Yuan,

Lin Yuan would… report him to the Goddess of Wisdom.

Can’t beat you? Couldn’t I still report you?

Of course,

Lin Yuan felt it unlikely that Lord Xiangwen would come.

It was even possible that Lord Xiangwen was not even aware of who Lin Yuan was.

“I hope Mr. Lin’s path of evolution will always be smooth…” the blond middle-aged man’s face was ashen.

Implicitly suggesting that Lin Yuan should not look to the Xiangwen Group for help in the future.

“Get out.”

Lin Yuan directly kicked the blond middle-aged man out of his personal room.

Once Lin Yuan stepped into Sixth Rank, he could openly reveal his identity as the Peak Master of the thirteenth peak of the Red Kun Lineage.

By then, forces like the Xiangwen Group would be too eager to curry favor with Lin Yuan.

…

Personal space.

Lin Yuan sat alone on a wooden chair.

“Arena competitions…”

Lin Yuan pondered with a thoughtful expression.

Arena competitions are one of the hottest, most attention-grabbing activities within the Human Civilization Alliance.

And being hot and attention-grabbing means enormous traffic.

This traffic leads to a series of industry chains involving massive amounts of money.

Why would groups like the Xiangwen Group or other powerful financial oligarchies specially train teams to participate in various arena competitions?

Could it really just be for honor or something like that?

Of course not!

If an Evolver can advance to a certain rank in the arena competition, like top hundred or top ten, they’re sure to attract a lot of attention.

At that time, just placing an advertisement or printing a logo of some group or oligarchy on their clothing could generate enormous popularity.

And advertising is just the most common method of monetization.

Each session of the arena competitions also features ‘betting houses’ set up beforehand.

Before the competition, you choose a competitor you think will win. If they do, you’ll receive a significant sum of money in accordance with the odds.

Of course,

To ensure fairness,

Under the scrutiny of the Goddess of Wisdom, the possibility of ‘fixed matches’ is nearly eliminated.

It is for this reason that all major forces and financial oligarchies are very keen on finding potential Evolvers from obscure middle-grade life planets and then supporting them to participate in star system and star domain level arena competitions.

These Evolvers from middle-grade life planets, with low exposure and no systematic training,

If they receive support from a major force, their strength can significantly improve in a short period of time.

When the star domain level arena competitions begin, they will enter the arena as ‘dark horses.’

After all, in the eyes of most citizens, a player who has already gained some fame and has completed ten consecutive wins, twenty consecutive wins, battling against someone who has never been heard of before,

Most citizens would definitely bet on the former to win.

…

Besides the two methods mentioned above.
